inspected: finalsource/be/src/modules/user/user.entity.ts: Users.user_id, full_name, email UNIQUE, username NOT NULL UNIQUE, password
finalsource/be/src/modules/account/account.entity.ts, bill/bill.entity.ts and goal/goal.entity.ts: existing user_id relations
finalsource/be/src/config/database.config.ts: synchronize=false; no migration file in finalsource

scope.runtime_metadata_status: Not verified for this run; Docker Compose services are not running. The earlier incident is evidence of a mismatch, not proof of current database contents.
out_of_scope: Changing Account, Bill, Goal or other owned-table structures
Adding a username requirement to the registration API
Dropping a populated legacy Users table or its data

recommended_mapping.rationale: Persist the validated NFC/trimmed full name; retain inherited capacity while the 4-25 rule is enforced in the service
Persist lowercase/trimmed email and enforce BR-REG-03/10 at the database boundary
Persist bcrypt cost-10 hash before User insert; no plaintext password or confirmation column

relationships.existing_user_id_references: Preserve Account/Bill/Goal user_id relationships and their current ON DELETE behavior; the User entity mapping must continue to resolve them. No new cascade or foreign key is proposed for UC-01.
relationships.owner_scope: A created User is identified by its generated id; registration accepts no client owner id.

sensitive_data.password_hash_storage: bcrypt cost 10, hash generated before persistence
sensitive_data.default_orm_selection: passwordHash excluded by default; explicitly select only for a future password-verification operation when authorized
sensitive_data.retention_or_deletion: No new deletion policy in UC-01; preserve existing data and relationships.

migration.name: <timestamp>-create-users-for-uc01.ts
migration.preflight: Inspect the target MySQL metadata read-only before application. If users exists with the proposed columns and unique email constraint, make no DDL change and align only the TypeORM mapping. If Users or users exists with incompatible columns, constraints, dependent foreign keys or populated data, stop for a separate reviewed migration rather than converting or dropping it silently.
migration.forward_if_absent: Create lowercase users with the four proposed columns, primary key on id and uq_users_email; keep TypeORM synchronize=false. No timestamps or additional profile columns are needed by UC-01.
migration.rollback_if_created: Drop only the table created by this migration, and only after verifying it has no users or dependent rows; otherwise stop for manual data-preserving rollback review.
migration.risk: A pre-existing case-sensitive Users table or foreign keys may require a separate data-preserving migration. Creating users beside a populated Users table could split identities, so that state is a blocker.
migration.deployment: Apply an approved migration through the project's database deployment path before enabling registration; preserve the existing volume and do not enable synchronization.

assumptions: Use INT UNSIGNED for generated User.id because the frozen UML states Integer but does not define width or signedness.
Keep VARCHAR(255) storage for full_name and password_hash for compatibility; service validation enforces the stricter full-name rule and bcrypt cost.
Store only normalized lowercase/trimmed email, allowing the existing MySQL unique email index to protect concurrent inserts.
No username, phone number, balance or profile field is required for this registration operation; do not fabricate one to satisfy an inherited entity mapping.
No new timestamp, cascade, deletion or data-retention behavior is authorized by UC-01.
